name: Incoming Gumdrop
summary: In Ironforge, Talvash del Kissel has a Gnomeregan Gumdrop for a sick child in Stormwind. He asks for a train impression before handing it over.

sections.title: A Whimsical Toll
sections.body: At Hallow’s End, trick-or-treaters seek treats from the Alliance strongholds. In Ironforge’s Mystic Ward, Talvash del Kissel keeps the Gnomeregan Gumdrop. He feels for the young orphan who wants it, but asks anyone seeking the sweet to bring some mischief to the holiday with a convincing train impression.

sections.title: Holiday Charity
sections.body: Jesper, an ailing orphan in Stormwind City, hopes for four treats from across the Alliance: nougat from Stormwind, a mint from Ironforge, marzipan from Darnassus, and a gumdrop from Gnomeregan. A chugging locomotive impression entertains Talvash and earns the gumdrop, bringing Jesper closer to his holiday wish.

faq.q: What do I need to do to complete Incoming Gumdrop?
faq.answer: Target Talvash del Kissel and use the train gesture to make an impression. Once he hears the train noise, he hands over the Gnomeregan Gumdrop.
Talvash del Kissel is a gnome jeweler from Gnomeregan who lives in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward. During Hallow’s End, he gives out Gnomeregan’s signature gumdrops to the Alliance.

faq.q: What is the Gnomeregan Gumdrop used for?
faq.answer: The Gnomeregan Gumdrop is one of four Hallow’s End treats gathered for Jesper, an orphan boy resting in Stormwind City’s orphanage.

faq.q: Where can Talvash del Kissel be found?
faq.answer: Talvash can be found in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward.

faq.q: Why does Talvash make you imitate a train?
faq.answer: Hallow’s End brings trick-or-treating, and Talvash asks for a harmless trick before handing over his treat: a locomotive impression.

aliases: can i do incoming gumdrop anytime
faq.answer: No. It is available only during the annual autumn festival of Hallow’s End.

angles.text: As a gnome in Tinker Town, offering a Gnomeregan Gumdrop during Hallow’s End can bring a cheerful reminder of home and mechanical ingenuity amid your people’s displacement.
As an Alliance hero, you travel through the kingdoms for a festival gumdrop, helping an ailing child in Stormwind share in the holiday.
